title: Welcome to Batchlog 1.0
body:
### Community

- Join the community forum to start discussions, reply, share photos, and attach your public recipes or active batches.
- Add friends, respond to friend requests, and send private messages to your friends.

### Your profile

- Show off your brewing with the profile showcase: a short message, a banner, and a featured public recipe.
- Follow your brewing journey with user statistics for batches, recipes, public recipes, and forum posts.
- Earn 50 achievements and tap any of them to see how to unlock it.

### Settings

- Make Batchlog your own with the full settings page, including your choice of site accent color.
- Manage your account security, email address, and profile visibility, and back up or restore your data.

### Inventory

- Keep track of your ingredients and equipment with the updated inventory page and system, now with more categories.

### Brewing tools

- Plan your batches with the updated ABV, target-strength, and dilution tools, now with clearer handling of invalid inputs.

### Notifications

- Stay up to date with the notification system: forum replies, friend requests, and messages in one place.
- Get built-in reminders for your batches and gravity checks.
